type.description: Define the type of container - Only applies to `initContainers`

enabled.description: Define if the init container is enabled or not

command.description: Define command(s). If it's single, can be defined as string

args.description: Define arg(s). If it's single, can be defined as string

env.description: Define env(s) for the init container

envFrom.description: Define envFrom for the init container

resources.description: The resources that the init container can use.

securityContext.description: Define securityContext for the init container

termination.description: Define termination for the init container

probes.description: Accepted for compatibility with the shared container shape. The init container spawner replaces probes with disabled probes.
